parts:

I am trying to get download soil data from soilgrid.org to incorporate it into wallace. But it is only available at the scale of 200km* 200km,I want to download it at a global level which is taking too much time.Can you provide an alternative for it.

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: regarding soil variables
parts: I do not know of any alternatives. Working with high resolution data can be time consuming and computationally heavy. My recommendation is to clip your data to your study extent to make working with it easier. If you need it at a global level, try a coarser resolution.
